description_sq:
Apartament 2+1 ne shitje te Univers CIty! 
I ndodhur ne nje prej zonave me te zhvilluara shume prane qendres tregtare QTU, kompleksi Univers City eshte projekti me i madh urban ne Tirane me sukses te garantuar nga nje prej kompanive me ne emer ne treg. 
Univers City përbëhet nga ndërtesa me njësi të shumëllojshme banimi dhe shërbimi si dhe infrastrukturë të plotë për një jetesë komode në një komunitet rezidencial. 
Apartamenti i tipologjise 2+1 ka nje planimetri perfekte dhe organizim te rregullt, ku hyrja realizohet nepermjet nje korridori shperndares per ne dhomen e ndenjes, dhomat e gjumit dhe tualetit me dritare. Komunikimi me ballkonin realizohet nga dhoma e gjumit. 
Bashke me apartamentin ofrohet nje post parkimi me cmim 16.000 Euro. 
Ky apartament vjen me nje cmim okazion ne nje zone qe po njeh shitje rekord.
title_en: Univers City, Tirana, Apartment For Sale 2+1!
description_en: 2+1 apartment for sale in Univers City! Located in one of the most developed areas very close to the QTU shopping center, the Univers City complex is the largest urban project in Tirana with success guaranteed by one of the most renowned companies in the market. Univers City consists of buildings with various residential and service units as well as complete infrastructure for a comfortable living in a residential community. The apartment of typology 2+1 has a perfect layout and regular organization, where the entrance is made through a distribution corridor to the living room, the bedrooms and the toilet with windows. Communication with the balcony is realized from the bedroom. Along with the apartment, a parking post is offered at the price of 16,000 Euros. This apartment comes with a bargain price in an area that is experiencing record sales.
